words_intro: No spoilers in these lists: titles, spellings and general words like "ending". Tap a word to copy it, or copy a group (one per line).
same_size: Same list size in every language.
core_sub: Hides spoiler talk, keeps news and trailers.
strict_sub: Every spelling of the title. Hides almost everything.
names_sub: a name can be a spoiler on its own, open only if you know them
plat_x: Settings and privacy, Privacy and safety, Mute and block, Muted words. Pick "Forever".
plat_threads: Settings, Privacy, Hidden words, custom words and phrases.
plat_tiktok: Settings and privacy, Content preferences, Filter keywords. Captions and hashtags only.
plat_youtube: "Not interested" and "Don't recommend channel". Comments and Shorts stay unfiltered.
plat_reddit: Mute communities from their menu. Titles in r/popular still get through.
plat_discord: Mute busy servers and channels for the first weeks.
miss1: A thumbnail can show the twist with no words at all.
miss3: Friends and group chats. Tell them early you have not seen it.
ext_p: Pure Spoiler Blocker has a ready list for {name}. It blurs matching videos, posts and comments on YouTube, Reddit and X, and keeps trailers and news.
ext_small: Also for Firefox. Checked in your browser, no account. Reads text only, desktop browsers only. I build it.
